account_id.description: This is the account-id that is provided by Trunkingio for your account

api_token.description: API token to use for authentication generated for you using Trunkingio admin portal. Preferred and required if `username` and `password` are not set.

enable_provisioning.description: If this parameter is set to `true` then the ability to active numbers will be enabled. If set to `false` then the module will only perform number searches.

generate_jwt_auth_token.description: If set to true, a new JWT Auth Token will be generated for calling Trunking.io API on behalf of reseller account, if no Trunking.io api token is configured on the account.

inbound_hook_secret.description: Shared secret to authenticate system-level inbound hook from Trunking.io

password.description: Password to log into the api with, as alternative for using API token. If you don't have API token, **both** `username` and `password` is required.

sandbox_provisioning.description: Intended to be used with `enable_provisioning`. If set to `true` then all number provisioning will pretend to be successful without actually activating.

session_id.description: Session Id for authentication, as alternative to API token. Setting username and password are required.

use_system_tio_account.description: Should use system level Trunking.io account if the reseller account is not linked to Trunking.io

username.description: Username to log into the api with, as alternative for using API token. If you don't have API token, **both** `username` and `password` is required.
